gates.name: server-ruff-check
gates.command: cd server && uv run ruff check .

gates.name: server-ruff-format
gates.command: cd server && uv run ruff format --check .

gates.name: contract-schema
gates.command: cd server && uv run python -m app.contracts check

gates.name: migration-check
gates.command: cd server && uv run alembic downgrade base && uv run alembic upgrade head

gates.name: image-contracts
gates.command: docker run --rm inkwell-ai-server:ci python -m app.contracts check

gates.name: compose-config
gates.command: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml config -q && docker compose -f deploy/compose.test.yml config -q

gates.name: backup-restore
gates.command: shellcheck deploy/backup.sh deploy/restore.sh tests/ops/backup_restore_test.sh && bash tests/ops/backup_restore_test.sh
